title: HASTE: A Hardware-Aware End-to-End ANN-to-SNN Toolchain With HDL Co-Simulation
description: Code and artifacts for the HASTE toolchain: GUI, ANN training and ANN-to-SNN conversion, bit-exact and floating-point reference models, Brian2 baseline, parameterised SystemVerilog cores (LIF, Izhikevich, Hodgkin-Huxley) with their memory-image generator, Verilator/Questa testbenches, Vivado scripts and a Zynq on-board measurement kit. Includes the trained weights, generated memory images, encoded spike trains and result files behind the paper.
